scope: One pinned TypeScript method, real temporary SQLite, controlled process/clock actions; QuickJS evaluates the guest. No whole-app, Discord, multi-tenant security or production validation claim.
newContract: An explicitly added 60-second claim expiry, preserved eligibility and payloads, and monotonically incremented durable claim generations. Existing TEND did not define this expiry policy.
instrumentation: Completion is a local fixture using a fixed generation check outside candidate code. This guard is new RaceLab instrumentation, not the unchanged TEND completeFollowUp method.
retention: Retain incomplete and failed attempts, source, output, and verification. No automatic transport retry or overwriting a retained investigation to select a nicer run.
success: A completed probe exposes an original-input contract failure and a Meta-generated method passes all ten fixed conditions. This does not establish superiority over a direct repair model or generalization to other repositories.
